body:
Goal: implement spec §7 generators 7.1–7.6, checks 7.7–7.9, tests 7.12, website/env-docs.json, and the GEN-owned reference pages listed in §4 ([GEN]).

Do:
1. website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs using only node: built-ins and regexes (no acorn, no import()/require() of repo code). Flags per §7: --only <cli|env|layout|docs-md|modules|root-docs>, --env-only, --extra-token NAME (repeatable), --check. Output to website/generated/ (sorted, no timestamps, byte-identical across runs); failures print <file>:<line>: <reason> and exit 1.
2. website/env-docs.json per §7.2: vars + ignore (with reasons, confirmed at each use site), all required vars entries listed in §7.2, ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT security text containing "disables token auth", internal/test-only group not rendered, bundledIgnored true exactly where an IS_BUNDLED/__AGB_BUNDLED__ guard exists (find with grep -n "IS_BUNDLED\|__AGB_BUNDLED__" lib/*.mjs bin/*.mjs); list AGENTS.md vs code disagreements in the PR description, do not edit AGENTS.md. Scan roots: lib bin mcp hooks sidecars and root scripts/ (not website/).
3. root-docs generator rewrites repo-relative links in CONTRIBUTING.md/CHANGELOG.md to blob/main file links.
4. website/scripts/stale-claims.json copied from §6 Pattern column; check-stale-claims.mjs (--with-root, --final), check-evidence.mjs, check-known-issues.mjs, check-schema-drift.mjs (skips placeholders); update check-all.mjs to run 7.7, 7.8 (site only), 7.9, 7.10 and gen --check.
5. Tests in website/scripts/test/ per §7.12 incl. parser negative fixtures (spread, computed key) and the env negative fixture.
6. Replace placeholders for reference/cli/** (one page per command including removed), slash-commands, agents, skills, environment, plugin-layout, mcp-tools and internals/module-map with prose wrappers that <include> the generated partials. Add Known issue callouts in the exact form "Known issue (T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT item N)" for items 2 and 3 on mcp-tools (§10.3, C6, C33) and item 1 on cli/sweep.

This is a docs ticket: do not edit code or bundles — git diff --quiet origin/main -- lib bin mcp hooks sidecars scripts dist vendor; echo $? must print 0 (AC3). Do not edit AGENTS.md (AC23) or anything under .github/ (AC27). Do not hardcode test or dependency counts (N6). Every claim you write about behavior must be re-read in source at tag v1.0.0; record claim ids from spec §6 in the page frontmatter `claims:` and link each with a https://github.com/voodootikigod/antigravity-booster/blob/v1.0.0/<path>#L<n> permalink whose link text is the id, e.g. [C4](...) (D11). If code disagrees with §6, code wins; say which row was wrong in the PR description.

Context: repo antigravity-booster (agb), plugin v1.0.0. Spec: .adlc/specs/docs-site.md (revision 3: Vercel hosting, default Next.js server output) — read it first; section references below point into it. Use Node >= 22.19.0. Work on a branch off origin/main; never push to or merge into main (merge is the owner's decision).

Hard constraints: never modify .adlc/config.json (including acknowledgedNewRailBypass / trustedCodeownersAttested), lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs or CODEOWNERS (these are this ticket's rails). 

Base / prerequisites: website/ does not exist at origin/main 4864376. Start only after T-DOCS-SCAFFOLD is merged to main, then branch off the updated origin/main (not 4864376). If it is not merged yet, stop and report; do not scaffold or create check scripts yourself. 
Resolved ambiguities:
- Ownership: SCAFFOLD created check-all.mjs, check-ia.mjs, check-site.mjs, ia.json and package.json scripts (gen, check, test already exist). You edit check-all.mjs (remove the skip logic for the scripts you add) and create the new files; do not change check-ia/check-site/ia.json except to fix a bug you document. In website/package.json touch only `scripts`; no new dependencies (tests use node --test).
- COMMANDS: read bin/agb.mjs at your base and model the parser on its actual literal (keys, `args`, `desc`, alias/flag fields). One page per COMMANDS key, plus cli/index and cli/removed (removed/deprecated commands found in bin/agb.mjs's unknown-command / removed handling). Entries with no §4 page (help, --version) are listed on cli/index only. If §4's list differs from COMMANDS, code wins; list the difference.
- Generated MDX format: one `.mdx` partial per subject under website/generated/, a heading-free body (wrapper page owns headings), markdown tables with columns stated per generator (CLI: Flag | Argument | Description; env: Name | Default | Description | Bundled), sorted by name; escape `{`, `}`, `<`, `>` and `|` in cell text as HTML entities.
- Schema drift (7.7): parse `<TypeTable type={{ fieldName: {...}, ... }} />` top-level keys; test only with fixtures (pages are placeholders now).
- Env scan: files `*.mjs *.cjs *.js` under lib bin mcp hooks sidecars scripts (exclude dist/, node_modules/, test/, website/); tokens matching `\b(AGB|ADLC|ANTIGRAVITY)_[A-Z0-9_]+\b` including in comments; a `vars` name not found in code fails at env-docs.json:<line>. Groups: core, plugin-resolution, sandbox-and-gates, pools-and-quota, sidecar, paths, adlc, internal/test-only. Descriptions need no permalinks; the environment.mdx wrapper carries claims C2, C3, C8, C17, C18, C19 with permalinks. bundledIgnored: decide per guard by reading each IS_BUNDLED/__AGB_BUNDLED__ site (including prefix helpers for AGB_ALLOW_* / AGB_DEV_*); list each mapping in the PR description.
- Claims on GEN pages go on the wrapper pages only, per the §6 target-pages column (`cli/*` means the specific cli page whose command the row names; C15 goes on cli/migrate). Generated partials contain no #L links.
- Known-issue callouts: on cli/sweep, directly under the page intro; on mcp-tools, next to the affected tool/serverInfo text.

Conventions (apply to every page you write):
- Frontmatter `claims:` is a YAML list of id strings, e.g. `claims: [C4, C21]`. Pages with no §6 row assigned omit `claims:`. Other behavior statements on any page still get a blob/v1.0.0/<path>#L<n> permalink with descriptive link text (no id). One permalink per claim id is the minimum; add more when one id covers several facts on different lines.
- Rows citing only a file (no line) mean: find the line yourself at v1.0.0 (`git show v1.0.0:<path> | grep -n ...`).
- A fact that landed after v1.0.0 (e.g. CI rails-guard reading .adlc/tickets/, #87, commit a99b3cd, not an ancestor of v1.0.0) is linked at blob/a99b3cd/... instead, and the PR description says so. Do not revert docs to pre-#87 behavior.
- Known-issue markup: `<Callout type="warn" title="Known issue (T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT item N)">one-paragraph description</Callout>` (fumadocs-ui default MDX component; the title text is exact).
- Historical markup: the first body element is `<Callout type="info" title="Historical, superseded">...</Callout>`.
- Internal links: root-relative, e.g. `/docs/reference/security` (no basePath; the site is served at the Vercel domain root). Repo files outside website/: https://github.com/voodootikigod/antigravity-booster/blob/main/<path> (no #L on blob/main links).
- Reading rail files (lib/gates.mjs, lib/lock.mjs) for evidence is allowed; editing them is not.
- Spec errors: never edit .adlc/specs/docs-site.md; list each wrong §6 row (and what code says) in the PR description.
- Content source order: code at v1.0.0, then the root doc named in §4/§5 at origin/main. Depth: cover every bullet in §4 for the page; done = those bullets covered with evidence and all checks pass.

Operational notes:
- Run commands from the repo root; lines beginning `cd website &&` run in a subshell, e.g. `(cd website && npm ci)`.
- `npm test` is the required gate. `unshare -r -n npm test` is informational: run it if user namespaces are available and paste the output; if unsupported, say so. `cd website && npm ci` needs network and is not run under unshare.
- AC30 `gate-manifest record` writes .adlc/manifest.jsonl, which is untracked at 4864376: do not commit it; paste the `verify` output. If record fails for environmental reasons (e.g. missing ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY), paste the error; it is an audit gate and does not block the PR (AGENTS.md degrade rule).
- The follow-up chore PR touches only .adlc/tickets/ and .adlc/ticket-archive/ (ticket complete/archive); it is not part of this ticket's scope.

Verification (run each, show output in the PR description):
- npm test (root suite passes; spec AC1, also try: unshare -r -n npm test)
- git diff --quiet origin/main -- .adlc/config.json; echo $?   -> 0 (AC29)
- npx adlc rails-guard --base origin/main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs --rails .adlc/config.json --rails CODEOWNERS; echo $?   -> 0 (AC22)
- npm test && npx adlc gate-manifest record tests --ticket T-DOCS-GEN && npx adlc gate-manifest verify; echo $?   -> 0 (AC30)

- cd website && npm ci && npm run build && npm run check:site; echo $?   -> 0 (AC8, AC9; check:site starts next start on 127.0.0.1 and stays offline)
- cd website && npm run lint:links; echo $?   -> 0
- node website/scripts/check-ia.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (AC13)
- node website/scripts/check-all.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (includes gen --check, stale claims, evidence, known issues)
- node website/scripts/check-stale-claims.mjs && node website/scripts/check-evidence.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (AC15, AC17)
- node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check; echo $?   -> 0 (AC10)
- cd website && npm run gen && npm run gen && git diff --exit-code -- generated; echo $?   -> 0 (AC11)
- node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --env-only --check --extra-token AGB_FAKE_UNDOCUMENTED; echo $?   -> 1 and output names AGB_FAKE_UNDOCUMENTED (AC12)
- grep "ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT" website/generated/environment.mdx | grep -c "disables token auth"   -> >= 1 (AC18)
- grep -nE "import\(|require\(|from ['\"]\.\./\.\./" website/scripts/*.mjs   -> no repo-code imports
- cd website && npm test; echo $?   -> 0 (AC25)
- node website/scripts/check-known-issues.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (AC32)

Finish: open a PR (not merged by you). After merge, in a follow-up chore PR, run npx adlc ticket complete T-DOCS-GEN --write --authorize then npx adlc ticket archive T-DOCS-GEN --write --authorize (AC31). Archive this ticket after merge.
title: Build the static reference generators, env-docs.json and consistency checks
